 The two sides meet again just days after Everton’s 3-1 victory over Newcastle in the fourth round of the EFL Cup. The Toffees will be looking to repeat that result, while the Magpies have an immediate opportunity to respond in front of their home supporters.

 Newcastle vs. Everton - Head-to-head record
 Everton have enjoyed the better results in this fixture recently , winning five of the last 10 meetings, compared with three victories for Newcastle and two draws. The Toffees have also won three consecutive matches against the Magpies across all competitions.
 Their latest success came in Thursday’s League Cup encounter, when Everton secured a 3-1 victory at the Hill Dickinson Stadium. Newcastle had also lost their previous meeting at St James’ Park, going down 3-2 in February 2026.
 Overall, Everton have won three of their last four matches against Newcastle, with the Magpies’ only victory in their last seven encounters coming in a 4-1 away win in November 2025. The recent record gives the visitors confidence, although Newcastle will hope home advantage helps them turn the tide.

 Newcastle - Searching for consistency at home
 Here we will take a closer look at Newcastle’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s inconsistent run of form and their latest results. We will also provide insight into the expected Newcastle vs. Everton line-ups for this crucial home fixture.
 Recent form
 Newcastle sit in the top half of the Premier League table, but their performances have been inconsistent under Matthias Jaissle . They ended a difficult run in the league with a 2-0 victory away to Crystal Palace, but Thursday’s 3-1 League Cup defeat to Everton was another setback.
 The Magpies have lost three of their last four matches across all competitions, including defeats to Coventry, Aston Villa and Everton. Their defensive record is a particular concern: they conceded 14 goals in their first eight Premier League games, more than any other top-10 side at that stage.
 Home form has also been disappointing. Newcastle have won just one of their four league matches at St James’ Park this season and are yet to keep a clean sheet at the stadium in any competition, conceding eight goals across five home games.
 The hosts have several availability concerns ahead of Monday’s rematch. Ewen Jaouen and Tino Livramento are ruled out, while Will Osula, Lewis Miley and Matias Fernandez-Pardo are doubts. Osula twisted his ankle during the League Cup defeat, so Yoane Wissa could come into the starting side.

 Everton - Fresh from beating Newcastle
 Let’s take a look at the Toffees. We’ll analyse their current form, expectations for the game, and which players could be decisive at St. James’ Park.
 Recent form
 Everton head to St James’ Park after a confidence-boosting 3-1 League Cup win over Newcastle. However, their Premier League form has been less convincing, with David Moyes’ side losing their last two matches without scoring.
 The Toffees were beaten 2-0 by Arsenal in their most recent league outing, following a 2-0 home defeat to Chelsea. They had previously enjoyed an unbeaten start to the campaign across their first six league matches, but their momentum has since faded.
 Away form remains a significant concern. Everton have drawn three and lost one of their four Premier League away games this season, scoring just three goals and conceding five. They still await their first league win on the road.
 There are also questions over Jack Grealish’s availability . The winger was left out of the squad against Arsenal after reportedly missing a training session, and it remains uncertain whether he will return for Monday’s fixture. Jarrad Branthwaite, meanwhile, is expected to complete concussion protocols in time to feature.

 Predictions for Newcastle vs. Everton - A decisive outcome expected
 Newcastle are out for revenge after their recent cup defeat to Everton. Playing at St. James’ Park, the Magpies will likely start on the front foot, making “Over 0.5 goals in the first half” a real possibility.
 Everton travel with confidence following that victory, but their poor away form in the league is a concern. With Newcastle pushing forward, this match is unlikely to be a cagey affair, so a decisive result seems probable.
 Considering the home side’s motivation and the visitors’ recent success, a draw appears unlikely. Therefore, our main prediction is for an open game with a clear winner and several goals, favouring the “Either team to win and over 2.5 goals” market.
